footer.about: The course platform of MLOps MENA Community, a bilingual community for ML, MLOps and AI engineers across the MENA region.

home.title: Learn to ship ML and AI systems to production, live, with engineers from the region
home.subtitle: Cohort-based courses taught live by practitioners, in Arabic and English. Free community courses and paid deep-dives.
home.step1Body: Tell us about your background and goals. It takes about five minutes.
home.step2Body: Answer a few short questions so instructors can shape each cohort.
home.step3Body: Join live sessions, catch up on recordings, and track your progress.

account.title: Account
account.changeEmailHint: We'll send a confirmation link to the new address. Your login email changes only after you confirm it.
account.emailChangeSent: Confirmation link sent to the new address.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Please log in again.
account.googleOnly: You sign in with Google. You can also set a password.
account.exportBody: Get a copy of everything we store about you, as a JSON file.
account.deleteBody: Your account is closed immediately and your personal data is anonymised after 30 days. Payment records are kept in anonymised form for accounting. This can't be undone.

onboarding.title: Complete your profile
onboarding.subtitle: The required step takes about 3 minutes. Everything else is optional but helps us shape courses for you.
onboarding.doneBody: Your profile is ready. Next, browse courses and apply.

profile.title: My profile
profile.coreMissing: Complete the required details before you can apply to a course.
profile.reviewPrompt: It's been a while since you updated your profile. Is it still accurate?

sectionHints.core: Required before applying to any course.
sectionHints.professional: Helps instructors pitch sessions at the right level.
sectionHints.skills: Rate yourself honestly; this is only used to plan courses and cohorts.
sectionHints.goals: Tells us which courses to build next.
sectionHints.links: Optional. Your CV is private and only visible to academy admins.
sectionHints.community: You choose what we can do with your profile. Everything here is off unless you turn it on.

fields.interestedTopics: Topics you'd like future courses on
fields.cvPrivacy: Private: only academy admins can open it.

fields.shareWithPartnersHint: Only your profile (not your CV unless you upload one) is shared, and only with partners we vet. You can turn this off at any time.
